nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I want to say the Talent Show would be fun for the students, but I know that's not the only reason to host it. It's also profitable.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The talent show would cost us virtually nothing. We already have students who can run the technical stuff on the big stage, and because it's a Talent Show, the talent will come to us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And if we sell tickets to family and friends, we might even turn a small profit. That money could go towards the graduation activities you said needed funding.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ooh! You had me at 'profitable'!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about the rest of what I said?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's good too, but I like that last part the most!
$ZOE and Sam go through the rest of the recruits for the Talent Show!
Colt walks onstage with Denni, Dex, and Kevin.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, you three. Line up!
Denni, Dex, and Kevin get in a straight line.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What's going on? Why are we out here?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah, Dex and I kind of have to get back to lights and sound!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why do you need me here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You three are here to help me show off my talent.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Which is what? Being an arrogant jerk?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sticks and stones don't work on me, Sammy. This here is a demonstration of my skill at `borrowing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sticks and stones don't work on me, Sammy. This here is a demonstration of my skill at [color=#e23b3b][i]borrowing.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt walks from one of end of the line of the people onstage to the other. At the end, he turns to Sam and $ZOE and bows.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ta-da!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What did you do?
Colt fans out three wallets and grins.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hey, that's mine!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: How did you even do that? My wallet was in my `front` pocket!
nodes.text_bbcode: How did you even do that? My wallet was in my [color=#e23b3b][i]front[/i][/color] pocket!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `COLT!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]COLT![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And for my next trick...
He runs offstage with Denni in hot pursuit.
Erik steps on stage. Again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Another Paul Revere skit?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, unfortunately. But I was thinking about it, and interviewing Paul Revere isn't a talent.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I do have a talent for extreme hula hooping!
To the beat of conga drums, Erik hula hoops in various and unique fashions!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I call this move the Christmas Wrap!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can't... Look... Away...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's great, Erik! Uh, next!
Taylor in a beautiful dress and Brendan in a nice suit step onstage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor! You came to try out!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, yeah! I'm not going to skip out on this event!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know that being 'Prom Queen' isn't a talent, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, I know that. Otherwise, I would've won this stupid thing before it even started!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Brendan and I are waltzing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You can waltz?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Watch and see.
Spencer steps up to the plate. He sets up a folding table and chair and places a food cooler on the floor next to the chair.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm the best eater I know. My talent is eating 15 hot dogs in 1 minute.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, I've seen this before! It's... Weird.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can't wait. Let's do this. Go!
$ZOE starts the timer on her phone, as Spencer opens the cooler and begins inhaling hot dogs! Spencer eats one, then another, and another!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh my goodness!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's slurping them up like noodles!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stop!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hoo fany derf I erft?
Spencer swallows.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How many did I eat?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 15! Good job, Spence!
Spencer takes a bow and walks offstage.
Andrew walks onstage.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is `he` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: What is [color=#3b78e2][i]he[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'm here to try out. I think you should hear what I have to say. I am a monologuer.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I talk in monologue, and frankly, unlike some `hack actors`--
nodes.text_bbcode: I talk in monologue, and frankly, unlike some [color=#e23b3b][i]hack actors[/i][/color]--

nodes.text: He glares at Sam.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: --I take my craft seriously.
$ZOE restrains Sam before she can get up and charge him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for coming out. Why don't you go ahead, Andrew?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `To be or not to be... That is the question...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]To be or not to be... That is the question...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nicole steps center stage, wearing a bikini. When the spotlight shines on her, she smiles winningly at $ZOE and Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er... What's your talent again, Nicole?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Bikini wearing! I'm wearing a bikini. Don't I look great?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Next?
Ryan stumbles onstage, looking flustered and nervous.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'm here to read a poem that I wrote.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, no, no. No, no, no. `No.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, no, no. No, no, no. [color=#3b78e2][i]No.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: This is how I'm choosing to express myself!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe we should give him a chance...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't say I didn't warn you.
He unfolds a crumpled piece of paper and clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Okay. Here goes. This is entitled 'My Favorite Things About Girls'.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh boy.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: 'The first thing I notice on girls is their faces...'

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: 'It makes me want to take them to nice places...'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: 'Their arms are great too, and so is their hair...'

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: 'I try not to creep them out with my stare...'

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: 'And last but not least, I'll tell you the part I like `best...'`
nodes.text_bbcode: 'And last but not least, I'll tell you the part I like [color=#e23b3b][i]best...'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: 'The most wonderful part of a girl is her--'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stop! Stop. I don't need to hear anymore.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What? I was going to say 'personality'!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh. I'm `sure.` Get off the stage, Ryan!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh-huh. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]sure.[/i][/color] Get off the stage, Ryan!

nodes.text: He lifts up his hands and walks out.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Tough crowd.
The boys exchange glances.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess I could give Ben a boost.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sure, we can try it. Let's do this.
Ben runs from one end of the stage straight towards the other and jumps! Owen gives Ben a foothold and boosts him up...
Launching him way too high!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahhhh!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoops!
Ben flies past the basketball hoop and into a pile of backstage props!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Ben!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ow, ow, ow...
$ZOE jumps onstage as Owen hauls Ben to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Please say your leg's still intact.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm starting to think I'm cursed when it comes to this stupid stage. What was with that boost, Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Guess I'm too strong for my own good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Ben. Your ending is perfect the way it is.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nah, you're right. It needed more 'oomph.'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh! I've got it. I have a confetti popper in my locker that we can use at the end to make it look even more cool. I'll grab it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: As soon as I get ice for my leg...
Ben hobbles offstage with Owen dragging the props off behind him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope he's okay. I feel awful.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Buck up, $ZOE. Ben's a jock. He'll walk it off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides, we have the rest of the list to go through.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Dribbling? How fun can dribbling be?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really fun! Just try it. Both of you at the same time!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right, Social Chair. You got it.

Owen takes the ball down the length of the onstage court while Ben plays defense. He dribbles it forward and back, bounces it over Ben's head, then dribbles between his legs before he jumps up and makes a shot! It goes in!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah!
Ben catches the rebound, backs up across the stage to avoid Owen, then charges!
Halfway to the hoop, Ben slides on his knees towards the basket, keeping the ball at a low dribble before he grabs it and shoots! It arcs high up, hits the backboard, and goes in!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was perfect!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What did you guys think?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hmm, I liked it, but I'm going to have to practice that move some more.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I think we could have one last thing at the end.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah! I have a confetti popper in my locker that we can use to make the finale even more cool! I'll go grab it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben!
The boys joke and laugh as they leave the stage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That went really well! We're moving along quite nicely!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, but we still have more list to go.
Hector and Amanda leave the stage, unlit batons in hand, as $ZOE and Sam settle into their chairs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Glad I nipped that one in the bud.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, good call.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wish I'd said something...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Your shins okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll live. Can we just... Move on?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Next!
Ben and Owen step onstage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Ben! I haven't seen you in a while.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm busy. Emily and I had a month-a-versary recently, so we've been hanging out a lot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's where Emily and I honor how long we've been going out. You know, like an `anni`versary, but every `month.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's where Emily and I honor how long we've been going out. You know, like an [color=#e23b3b][i]anni[/i][/color]versary, but every [color=#e23b3b][i]month.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Isn't that cute?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Blech.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think it's sweet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You would. So what's your talent?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Since Owen and I are on the basketball team, I thought it'd be fitting to do a demonstration of our basketball skills.
Owen drags out a basketball hoop and two colorful basketballs.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ready?
An energetic song plays on the speakers. To the beat, Owen and Ben weave around each other on their makeshift court, catching long and complicated passes and making impossible shots!
At the end, Sam claps her hand, and $ZOE laughs.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What'd you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's great... But it needs an awesome ending. Maybe you can end by...

options.label: Boosting someone up to the hoop for a sweet dunk.
Dribbling the balls in a funny way before shooting.

nodes.text: $ZOE stands up and shouts right before Hector throws the baton.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stop! Freeze!
Hector clamps down on the flaming baton.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw, come on, $ZOE, this is the best part.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! No fire! Not again. I'm not going to pull the fire alarm here too! Put it out, Hector.
Amanda, still frozen in place, barely moves her mouth to speak.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Cern wer merve yet?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You can move, Manda-Panda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $ZOE, you sure you don't want us to do this? It'd be really `fun.`
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE, you sure you don't want us to do this? It'd be really [color=#e23b3b][i]fun.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah, $ZOE! These batons are my favorite!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Even though I always drop them. Fire is scary.
$ZOE glares at Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, she `may` be right. But relax, the batons are going out. We won't use them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, she [color=#e23b3b][i]may[/i][/color] be right. But relax, the batons are going out. We won't use them.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the rest of your show is amazing. You'll do that the night of the Talent Show, right?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Of course!
$ZOE says nothing, and Hector throws one of the flaming batons at Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh!
Amanda makes a grab for the baton, but distracted by the flames, she misses!
It sails into the curtain and $ZOE can see smoke curling up at its base.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `NO!`
$ZOE and Sam leap to their feet and rush to the edge of the stage. $ZOE tries to leap up, but she trips, banging her shins hard!
Sam clears the stage, runs for the fire extinguisher, and brings it to where the flames on the baton lick gleefully at the stage curtain.
`Pssssssshhhhttttttt!`

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Thanks, ow, Sam. Ow.
$ZOE nurses her bruised shin, as Sam sinks to the stage floor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Hector.`

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? It's the coolest part of our show.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Or the hottest, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to pull another fire alarm this year. Can we just... Not do the fire?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Fine... Spoilsport.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's just keep going. Next!
Hector and Amanda step onstage holding several tennis balls.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ladies and gentleman, without further ado, the famous jugglers Hector and Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's me!
Hector and Amanda stand a short distance away from one another and start juggling six tennis balls!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know, I make it look easy.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!
The juggling gets more and more complicated, and Hector starts adding rings and juggling bats to his and Amanda's routine.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't know Amanda was coordinated enough for this...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Neither did I! How am I doing, Hector?
A stray metallic ring bounces onto the floor.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Just focus on the shiny, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee!
They juggle for a while, ending with Amanda throwing all the rings at Hector. Hector catches them all on his neck!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Very good!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And now for our last act... Flaming batons!
Hector whips out two batons that burst into flames! He pulls his arm back to throw them...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He is?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, it's very important that people know their American history...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But if you're going to interview someone, it should be a person with more... Cultural impact.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Someone modern. Maybe a pop star? I mean, the interview you did was really funny.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It wasn't meant to be funny.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did a good job. It's just that Paul Revere seems, you know, uh... He's, uh... Old-fashioned.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You just said that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I meant it the first time.
Erik's face falls.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Paul Revere is a national hero! It's even in his name. 'Revere' means to admire or respect!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He was a clever and brave man. He can't ever be outdated because... Because bravery is never outdated!
Erik clutches his tricorne hat to his chest and runs off the stage.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... That went well?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was trying `not` to hurt his feelings.
nodes.text_bbcode: I was trying [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] to hurt his feelings.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You can't win them all.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I... I guess I knew that all along. But I was hoping something like this would help people really get to know him `better.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I guess I knew that all along. But I was hoping something like this would help people really get to know him [color=#e23b3b][i]better.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I would even say that some people don't know who Paul Revere `is.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I would even say that some people don't know who Paul Revere [color=#3b78e2][i]is.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Gasp! Some people don't know about Mr. Revere?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nope. So I'm sorry to say that I probably won't pick your interview for the Talent Show...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's fine! My calling is elsewhere! If there are people who don't know about him, then I have to let them know!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I must spread the news of Paul Revere's story!
Erik leaps off the stage, yelling.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The Paul Revere story is coming! The Paul Revere story is coming!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I do not get that kid.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sometimes, I don't either. But I hope he didn't take my leaving him out of the Talent Show too hard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you joking? He looked `ecstatic` to spread the joy of Paul Revere. I think you said the right thing.
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you joking? He looked [color=#3b78e2][i]ecstatic[/i][/color] to spread the joy of Paul Revere. I think you said the right thing.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really? Because I was worried--

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Look, Kevin, you can't get twisted up over her.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: If you do, then you'll be distracted forever! Kevincible will never make it to the town of Havenport, and Dex the Powerful is never going to purchase his new magic staff!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Priorities!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Dex, this is greater than Havenport. What do I do about Kimi? I don't want her to date someone else!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, maybe it's time to show her how strongly you feel.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I thought she knew.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Clearly not if she's going out with other guys. You need to show her. Do something about it!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: It's what Cameron would do, I'm sure.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Can we just never talk about him again?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Just trying to help. Kimi's interested in Cameron. Maybe if you're more like Cameron, she'll want to date you!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: A jock swimmer guy?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Pfft! As if you could pull that off with your body type.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: You don't need to be a swimmer. You just need to be a little more... Well, like a jerk.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Come again?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: The reason why Cameron's so appealing, aside from the fact that he's cute and charming, is that he's kind of aloof.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: When he hangs out with girls, he's a little insulting. But in a joking sort of way. It's... Fun and cute.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I do not understand girls.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Are you sure this is going to work on Kimi? How am I supposed to do that anyway? I'm not a jerk, I don't think.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: That's true...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: There's an easy solution here...
Dex holds up an empty role-playing character sheet and grins.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: How about a little role playing?
You are now playing as $ZOE.
After school, $ZOE and Sam sit in the theater to watch students try their set pieces out for the Talent Show!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, `this` feels familiar. I can't believe just last month we were sitting here, trying to put on a performance so that I could get help going to college. Now here `you` are.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] feels familiar. I can't believe just last month we were sitting here, trying to put on a performance so that I could get help going to college. Now here [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] are.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Funny how life is, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for coming and helping me screen people for the Talent Show.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks for helping me with my college essays. Which reminds me... I've got another one for you if you have the time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I should be able to take a look at it tonight...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Unless it takes us the rest of the afternoon to find people for the Talent Show...
Sam holds up a paper showing a long list of people that $ZOE's managed to convince into coming.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll just have to move through the list quickly. Remember, we're taking the best performances, the ones that are interesting, unique, and fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about the boring, every-day, not fun ones?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe we'll take some of those too for variety.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right, who's first?
Erik steps onstage with a tricorne hat, a wireless mic, and a big smile.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Erik! What's your talent?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My talent is channeling the voice of the historic figure and my personal hero, Paul Revere! For my show, I'm going to do an in-person interview with him!

nodes.text: We at Twin Branches High School are happy to have you! Paul Revere, history knows you best as the person who signaled the coming of British troops with just a lantern. How do you feel about that?

nodes.speaker: Erik

nodes.text: `My good friend William Dawes also had a hand in warning the colonies of the British troops' advance! I was not alone on that ride, so I'm afraid I can't take all the credit!`

nodes.speaker: Erik

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Fascinating! We're out of time, and that concludes this interview! Thank you, Paul Revere!

nodes.text: The next Surviving High School novel, `How to Be a Star` by M. Doty, is available `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The next Surviving High School novel, [color=#3b78e2][i]How to Be a Star[/i][/color] by M. Doty, is available [color=#3b78e2][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi

nodes.text_bbcode: And it's featuring none other than fabulous [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color] Finally, it's my turn to be in the spotlight... Literally!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Aaaand, that's it! Those were all the questions! See? Painless!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yep!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: You've convinced me, $ZOE. I'll make sure to squeeze your show in next Friday. And if everything goes perfectly, then we can probably say that you'll have a recommendation from me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I will? Thank you so much, Missy!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Uh-huh! Buh-bye now!
$ZOE hangs up the phone...
And sighs in relief!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As if dealing with the stage wasn't bad enough... I can't believe I had to talk to Missy at the same time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What'd she say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If she likes what she sees at the Talent Show here on Friday night, then I have a good shot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything just has to go perfectly, and...
$ZOE scans the stage one more time, eyeing the mess of glitter, the pile of partly stepped-on hotdogs, and the slightly singed curtain.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And then I'm in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hmm, better hope that things go smoother than they did today.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll keep my fingers crossed.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: $ZOE, when you said that you wanted a second chance, I totally jumped in to help you.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Once a cheerleader, always a cheerleader, I say! But if you're `too busy` to bother talking to me, you can totally forget it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Once a cheerleader, always a cheerleader, I say! But if you're [color=#3b78e2][i]too busy[/i][/color] to bother talking to me, you can totally forget it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Wait! Missy, I--
But the line goes dead, and as more chaos unfolds around her, $ZOE comes to the devastating realization...
She has failed.

nodes.text: $ZOE watches Spencer punch Andrew in the face!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eek!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: ...Punching? Did you say punching?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I, uh, guess I did? I can't remember...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: $ZOE, are you even listening to me?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I swear, I'm trying to-- Oh!
$ZOE sees Andrew sit up, his face red and blotchy.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Hats?

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I love hats!
$ZOE takes stock of the chaos onstage, and keeping her phone to her ear in one hand, she walks into the thick of the chaos to fix things.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I mean that I fill a lot of roles. I resolve conflict...
$ZOE finds Dex's wallet, which had fallen on the floor, and neatly steps in between Dex and Colt. She returns the wallet to Dex.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I manage people...
$ZOE grabs Erik's neon orange hula hoop out of his hands and lays it down on the ground around the hot dogs to keep people from stepping on them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'm a `great` leader.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm a [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] leader.

nodes.text: $ZOE grabs the confetti popper that Ben has dropped and throws it to the ground! The popper pops and bursts open, dousing people with colorful confetti and bright glitter!
It has the immediate effect of calming the crowd, so that people file out of the theater in a more orderly fashion.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aww, I was saving that for the dramatic ending.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale, I'm `sparkly.` Is this your fault?
nodes.text_bbcode: Kale, I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]sparkly.[/i][/color] Is this your fault?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Got to go!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: This is awfully pretty...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you like girly stuff.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Which I do.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right then.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE, you know you're going to have to clean this up, right?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, it's raining stars!
$ZOE nods as she points to the phone she's still on. When the theater finally empties out, $ZOE sinks into a chair, breathing deeply.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Well, `that` was quite a speech!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] was quite a speech!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I was disappointed when it seemed like you weren't going to be able to come to Kingston for cheerleading. But you turned out to be super cool otherwise.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you, Missy.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: That doesn't make sense. Are you even listening to me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-huh! I'm listening! I swear!
There's a loud yell, and $ZOE looks up in time to see Dex push Colt into one of the theater curtains!
She hears a large tearing sound as the curtain is torn completely from its rails.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The curtains!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I thought you'd be more respectful than this. It's very clear you're not focused, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: That doesn't make sense. Are you even listening to me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-huh! I'm listening! I swear!
There's a loud yell, and $ZOE looks up in time to see Dex push Colt into one of the theater curtains!
She hears a large tearing sound as the curtain is torn completely from its rails.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The curtains!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I thought you'd be more respectful than this. It's very clear you're not focused, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... A lot of different...
$ZOE loses her trail of thought as she dodges a prop that Dex has thrown at Colt.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cats?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Fire!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Fire![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Oh my!
On stage, several people jump up and leap away from the baton. Sam yanks the water bottle out of Spencer's hand and douses the flames before they can really catch.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Geez, that was close.
$ZOE presses her phone to her ear.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry about yelling, Missy...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: No, it didn't bother me a bit! I liked the way you said that you have so much fire. I love, love, `love` your enthusiasm, in fact!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it didn't bother me a bit! I liked the way you said that you have so much fire. I love, love, [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] your enthusiasm, in fact!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's... Fantastic! Yes, I have a lot of enthusiasm for the job. I love it and enjoy it.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Wonderful, wonderful. Moving right along!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: And this is the last question ever, I promise! Why do you think this Talent Show represents how good you are at your job as Social Chair?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The last question? Okay, the Talent Show is the `perfect` event to show off my skills because--
nodes.text_bbcode: The last question? Okay, the Talent Show is the [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect[/i][/color] event to show off my skills because--

nodes.text: But $ZOE gets no further.
Drawn by $ZOE's yell of fire, the performers who'd been waiting in the wings now flood out onto the stage en masse.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What happened? Is there a fire?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We don't need another fire alarm incident this late in the year...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Someone needs to make a fire, and I wasn't invited?
But the stage isn't big enough for everyone, and things start to go wrong! The crowd pushes Brendan into Ben!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa!
Ben trips into Owen who drops his basketball, hitting Amanda and Nicole in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Watch it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ow, basketball!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've got you, Amanda!
Hector tries to catch Amanda and trips over Spencer's cooler of food. Hector's juggling bats fly into the air, hot dogs spill to the floor, and people yelp as they step in the mess!
Mats from a martial arts performance get in people's way as they try to flee the stage. And downstage, Dex charges at Colt.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Colt! My wallet's missing! And I definitely know one person who has the `talent` to take it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt! My wallet's missing! And I definitely know one person who has the [color=#e23b3b][i]talent[/i][/color] to take it!

nodes.text: Dex jabs a finger in Colt's chest.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Watch it, nerd. Hands off the goods. I don't have your wallet!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I say you do!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Um, $ZOE? You were saying?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You asked me why the Talent Show proves I'm a good Social Chair?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It shows that I can wear a lot of different...
No one except for Missy seems to hear her, and $ZOE realizes she's shouted the wrong thing.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Excellent! Passion is great! But I totally want to know more!
$ZOE points at the flames, but no one notices!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My burning, `burning` passion!
nodes.text_bbcode: My burning, [color=#3b78e2][i]burning[/i][/color] passion!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Yes, I `know.` I heard you, $ZOE--
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, I [color=#3b78e2][i]know.[/i][/color] I heard you, $ZOE--

nodes.text: But $ZOE isn't listening to Missy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `My passion to put out this fire before we burn down this whole school!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]My passion to put out this fire before we burn down this whole school![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE grabs the water bottle from Spencer's hand and empties it on the flames! Several people jump up to their feet and help!
Soon, the flames are out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whew.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: $ZOE? $ZOE?! Are you doing something else?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, kind of...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I thought this was important enough to you that you'd be really focused with me. But you aren't focused at all!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Passion!
As $ZOE says this, she braces her phone against her shoulder with her neck and grabs Spencer's arm! Together, she and Sam separate Spencer from Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: He's a mad man!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Spencer, get ahold of yourself! He's not worth it! Don't get suspended this close to graduation!
Andrew runs away as $ZOE catches her breath.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ugh, I think I'm going to hurl.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess rage and hot dogs don't mix.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Can you elaborate more on how you pay attention to people?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, well, people come to me with events they want to hold or other needs...
$ZOE hands Spencer a water bottle to help his stomach.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I make sure to listen to them. If they want to get an internship over summer, for instance, I'll help coordinate an internship fair.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Wonderful! Now up next...
Oblivious to the brawl that nearly took place, Erik Ericson wanders onstage.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Am I next? $ZOE, you wouldn't believe what I found in the back! This will make my hula hoops more extreme than ever!
$ZOE's almost afraid to look.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I have a second question for you! What about your personality do you think makes you a good Social Chair?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, well, it's definitely my--
$ZOE gets distracted by Erik, who's found one of Hector and Amanda's flaming batons and lit it! He hula hoops cheerfully while twirling the baton!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: See? Extreme, am I right?
But Erik's boasting causes him to lose his concentration! The hula hoops clatters to the floor, and Erik trips over it! The flaming baton falls back onto the wooden stage.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I'm terribly sorry, $ZOE, but I can't hear you! There's a lot of interference! What did you say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm a good Social Chair because of my--
A wisp of smoke rises from the stage floor, and everyone else is still so busy talking about Spencer and Andrew's near-fight that they don't see it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...
$ZOE can't even think of what to say! So many thoughts rush through her head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Missy, I pay attention to, uh... Punching!
You are now playing as $ZOE.
Back onstage, $ZOE's finalized her list of contestants for the Talent Show!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'd like to thank everyone for coming out and showing off your talent!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here is the list of people who've made it into the Talent Show! Come see the list!
She puts the cast list up, and the performers swarm to see who's in.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Aw, man...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm not on the list? But my bikini act was so revealing!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Great, I'm in! Everyone, hold onto your wallets!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can't believe your criminal past is actually being rewarded!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just because you only carry two dollars in your wallet, doesn't mean you have to be bitter about it, Princess.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! Hot dog eating for the win!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Brendan, you and I are in!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are you `sure` this isn't a conflict of interest? Wouldn't being President make people more likely to vote for you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you [color=#e23b3b][i]sure[/i][/color] this isn't a conflict of interest? Wouldn't being President make people more likely to vote for you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't see the problem.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And so are we, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Awesome! And the Twin Branches Schooltrotters were born!
Amidst the chattering, $ZOE steps up onstage and gets everyone's attention.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The Talent Show is happening next Friday, so we'll be holding a rehearsal right now! The order I put you on the list is the order you'll be performing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So let's start at the beginning and run through it!
Everyone cheers, and soon, $ZOE and Sam are walking performers through the different acts!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...All right, Colt, after you picked your last pocket, you exit stage right. And then, Andrew comes on, and he'll be monologuing.
Andrew walks onstage and begins his monologue.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: For this monologue, I'm not going to do Hamlet. I'm going to do a piece I've written myself, entitled 'The Foibles of Others'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, okay. You should probably just stick to Shakespeare, but we'll hear this out.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Mankind, especially the kind of man that resides in high school, is full of weakness...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Mankind, especially the kind of man that resides in high school, is full of weakness...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `Some, who we will call Samanthas, are people who flagrantly disregard the arts and wrongly consider their productions better...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Some, who we will call Samanthas, are people who flagrantly disregard the arts and wrongly consider their productions better...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Andrew continues his speech, pacing to the far side of the stage. Sam leans over to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That guy is a nuisance... You should probably stop him...
$ZOE starts to stay something...
When her phone rings. She glances down at her screen and recognizes Missy's number!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is horrible timing...
The phone rings again. $ZOE glances at the performers onstage...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `And don't get me started on oafs like those on the football team whose intelligence falls short of average...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]And don't get me started on oafs like those on the football team whose intelligence falls short of average...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grrr...
Her phone rings again. $ZOE grits her teeth and takes the call.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: $ZOE! Hello, hi! I'm so, so glad I got a hold of you. Is this a good time?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, uh... Not really...
$ZOE looks over and sees Andrew is still monologuing, and people around him are getting more and more upset.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Well, I hate to be `rude`, but I only have a few minutes, and this is the only time I have today to talk about your Talent Show. I'm just running my poor high heels into the ground interviewing all these potential Kingston students!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I hate to be [color=#3b78e2][i]rude[/i][/color], but I only have a few minutes, and this is the only time I have today to talk about your Talent Show. I'm just running my poor high heels into the ground interviewing all these potential Kingston students!

nodes.text: $ZOE feels her stomach tighten.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, uh, well, I can make time, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Great! So I have some itty-bitty questions about your little Talent Show!
And that's when everything goes wrong!
Spencer jumps to his feet, anger in his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Heh, don't worry, $ZOE! These questions are just so `tiny`, I'm sure you'll be able to answer them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh, don't worry, $ZOE! These questions are just so [color=#3b78e2][i]tiny[/i][/color], I'm sure you'll be able to answer them.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: First question... What do you think the most important thing you've done as Social Chair is?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Missy, I, uh, I think--
Spencer stomps over to Andrew and grabs him by the collar!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who are you calling unintelligent?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Not you specifically... Just, uh, okay, fine, it is you. But it's a ranting monologue. It's art!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Art? Well, I'm going to Picasso your face!
$ZOE hurries to jump on stage! She and Sam sprint towards Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: $ZOE? I didn't hear your answer...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry! I, huff, was thinking, huff, about it! The most important thing I've, huff, done as Social Chair is...
Spencer draws his fist back to punch Andrew!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I don't give the time of day to stuck-up cheerleaders. I'm fine without you.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You... You're fine without me?
Kevin shrugs and turns away.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why? So I can just reject you again? Forget it...
Kevin is flustered and doesn't know what to say.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Wait... Why don't we start over?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You got me. So what?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: So... Are you going to give me your number? It's the least you could do for ruining my day.
Nicole steps back, seeing Kevin in a new light. Then her face crumples.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, wait, you're that Kevin nerd that hangs all over Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Gross. I don't give the time of day to `nerds.` Get out of my face.
nodes.text_bbcode: Gross. I don't give the time of day to [color=#3b78e2][i]nerds.[/i][/color] Get out of my face.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: That's not what 'Kev' would do. He'd be confident!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: No. I'm sorry that you thought it was your turn to go.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Girls like you think you're so important that it's always your right of way.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You totally noticed me.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You just didn't care. Girls like you think you're so important that it's always your right of way.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Um... Um...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Try not to swallow your tongue apologizing.
Dex points to another area in the wings where Nicole is fuming into her phone about being rejected from Talent Show auditions.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What? I don't want to flirt with someone else! This was for Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I know, but we have no conclusive evidence that your new persona is going to actually work. You can't practice on me. First, I'm not Kimi. Second, I'm not a girl! Be a scientist.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah, but flirting with Nicole? Isn't that, like, cheating or something?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You're fake flirting as a fake jock jerk. I'm pretty sure you're okay.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You ever have a girlfriend, Dex?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: In real life?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Who cares whether it was real or not? Just go try it out, Kevin. You don't want to go through all this trouble just to find out it doesn't work.
Kevin sighs and walks toward Nicole who has hung up and is idly checking her nails. Kevin can't find the courage to go up to her.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: 'Kev' wouldn't bat an eye approaching a girl!
He takes a deep breath and waits until she walks by before putting himself in her path.
She runs straight into him.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Whoops! Didn't notice you there...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What would 'Kev' say?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `I am?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I am?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `Oh, Kev! You're so confident that I must be with you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oh, Kev! You're so confident that I must be with you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Okay, we can stop now. You pretending to be Kimi is super creepy.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: And Kimi doesn't act all straightforward like that.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'll admit that I don't know the first thing about how to be a girl.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Clearly.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Which is why I've concluded that you've got to test this in the field. Go flirt with Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `What do you know, Kev? You're just some guy who only sometimes flirts with me and never asks me out on dates!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What do you know, Kev? You're just some guy who only sometimes flirts with me and never asks me out on dates![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `And Cameron is so cool! He has muscles and stuff the girls like!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]And Cameron is so cool! He has muscles and stuff the girls like![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: `I'm going to date him, and you can't stop me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm going to date him, and you can't stop me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kevin
